scope: Opted-in 2010 buffered canvas pixel tile cache, its exclusive ownership and lifecycle. The 2002/front canvas paths remain unopted.
checks: GdiTrace canonicalizes safe integer/BigInt coordinates to signed DWORDs before sampling. Cached reads retain out-of-range COLORREF and alpha-independent RGB extraction.
All supported buffer draws occur synchronously through the same sink; every non-read event clears tiles before drawing. Font drawing and setPixel use this sink.

paint creates a fresh buffered DC. selectBitmap clears/resizes its canvas before drawPaintContent and first sample; bitBlt reads that buffer into a separate front context. No later direct buffer mutation occurs during the cache lifetime.
Custom samplers/sinks and recorded traces retain their original unbatched contract. Four-row tiles clip at the bottom edge, and the sixty-four-entry reset changes only reread frequency.
